Looking at the computed styles for each node:

- `root` has `border-radius: 0px`
- `root>body` has `border-radius: 0px`
- `root>body>panel` has `border-radius: 12px`

Since `border-radius` is not an inherited CSS property, and only `root>body>panel` shows `border-radius: 12px` in its computed styles while its ancestors have `0px`, the border-radius declaration must come from the panel node's own CSS block.

ANSWER: root>body>panel
